summary: This is a routine 8-K filing by Highwoods Properties, Inc. reporting a modification to its existing $150.0 million unsecured bank term loan, extending the maturity from May 2027 to June 2029. The filing also describes interest rate adjustments based on credit ratings and sustainability goals. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or abrupt management change. This is a standard credit facility amendment and not a special situation.
